detects: login prints the full 'You're set' panel and starts capture, but never writes ~/.promptster-teams/credentials — the key is lost the moment the process exits
why: Medium difficulty, and the case that separates reading stdout from verifying. Every printed line is identical to a healthy run; the only difference is on disk. The agent has to run `inspect .promptster-teams/credentials` — which the feature map tells it to do under 'Proves it works' — or follow up with `doctor` and notice the key line never flipped.
